guide.removedRow: Mulberry is a vigorous deciduous tree grown for shade and fruit. It needs full sun and space. Water young trees regularly until established, then deep water during dry periods. Prune in winter to control height and shape. Keep fruiting varieties away from paving and cars because fruit can stain. Choose the right species or cultivar for your garden size.
guide.retainedCanonical: Mulberry is a productive deciduous fruit tree that needs full sun and room. Water while establishing; mature trees tolerate dry periods but fruit better with some irrigation. Plant away from paving and parking areas because fruit can stain. Prune in dormancy to control size. Choose fruitless or compact varieties when mess or size is a concern. Give roots space.
